t: You're looking at the Queen Elizabeth II Centre, a government-owned conference centre in Westminster, close to the Houses of Parliament, Westminster Abbey, Central Hall Westminster and Parliament Square. It can host conferences and exhibitions for up to thirteen hundred delegates. Queen Elizabeth II gives it its name, and she opened it in 1986. She reigned from 1952 until her death in 2022, seventy years and 214 days, the longest reign of any British monarch.
